description: This file implements the OAuth store for Mattermost, handling OAuth applications, access data, and auth data with database interactions.

classes.name: SqlOAuthStore
classes.description: Struct implementing OAuth storage with database interactions.

methods.name: newSqlOAuthStore
methods.description: Initializes a new SqlOAuthStore with prepared queries.

methods.name: SaveApp
methods.description: Saves a new OAuth application to the database.

methods.name: UpdateApp
methods.description: Updates an existing OAuth application in the database.

methods.name: GetApp
methods.description: Retrieves an OAuth application by its ID.

methods.name: GetAppByUser
methods.description: Retrieves OAuth applications created by a specific user.

methods.name: GetApps
methods.description: Retrieves a list of OAuth applications with pagination.

methods.name: GetAuthorizedApps
methods.description: Retrieves OAuth applications authorized by a specific user.

methods.name: DeleteApp
methods.description: Deletes an OAuth application and related sessions and tokens.

methods.name: SaveAccessData
methods.description: Stores OAuth access data.

methods.name: GetAccessData
methods.description: Retrieves OAuth access data by token.

methods.name: GetAccessDataByUserForApp
methods.description: Retrieves access data for a user and client application.

methods.name: GetAccessDataByRefreshToken
methods.description: Retrieves access data by refresh token.

methods.name: GetPreviousAccessData
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent previous access data for a user and client.

methods.name: UpdateAccessData
methods.description: Updates existing OAuth access data.

methods.name: RemoveAccessData
methods.description: Deletes OAuth access data by token.

methods.name: RemoveAllAccessData
methods.description: Deletes all OAuth access data.

methods.name: SaveAuthData
methods.description: Stores OAuth authorization data.

methods.name: GetAuthData
methods.description: Retrieves OAuth auth data by code.

methods.name: RemoveAuthData
methods.description: Deletes OAuth auth data by code.

methods.name: RemoveAuthDataByClientId
methods.description: Deletes OAuth auth data for a specific client and user.

methods.name: RemoveAuthDataByUserId
methods.description: Deletes OAuth auth data for a specific user.

methods.name: PermanentDeleteAuthDataByUser
methods.description: Permanently deletes OAuth access data for a user.

methods.name: deleteApp
methods.description: Deletes an OAuth application within a transaction.

methods.name: deleteOAuthAppSessions
methods.description: Deletes sessions associated with an OAuth app.

methods.name: deleteOAuthTokens
methods.description: Deletes OAuth access tokens for an app.

methods.name: deleteAppExtras
methods.description: Deletes preferences related to an OAuth app.
